svg.title: Fig. 3, Cairn
svg.desc: Figure 3, Cairn, open source · mit, exploded view. 1, cairn: The CLI: sets a project up and installs the hooks. 2, cairn-plugin: One agent plugin for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. 3, cairn-core: MCP server, hook runners and the sensors that read the project’s decisions and invariants. 4, cairn-state: Typed schemas and read-only state I/O. 5, cairn-lens: Hovers and code lens in the editor for invariant and task references. Check loop: Agent writes a diff, then Sensors check at pre-commit, then Commit, then CI checks again, then Hook bypasses flagged. The sensors catch stubs and changes that contradict a recorded decision. No longer maintained. Commits on main: 312 (since May 2026). Latest release: v0.33.0 (published July 2026). TypeScript files: 458 (across five packages). Computed 2026-10-31 at commit 7b771d2.
